title: TERRIBLE PRODUCT WITH TERRIBLE SUPPORT
review:
So, I finally got my VMKey today. Big moment, right? I plug it in, and, uh… yeah, it’s just static. A lot of static. Sounds like I’m broadcasting from the inside of a tin can during a hurricane. Spent 30 minutes looking for an answer, only to find out it’s—get this—because of the order you plug in the cables. Yeah, apparently, if you plug the mic in too early, it punishes you. That’s how they designed it. So now, I guess I’m on the VMKey’s schedule.

But here’s the kicker, folks. The big reason I bought the thing—the only reason—it doesn’t even let the mic pass through. Yeah, you try to talk, and you sound like Bumblebee from those Michael Bay movies. Real fun if you’re trying to DJ a soundboard, but not great if you want to, you know, talk. I give it negative ten stars. Out of five.

And the app? Oh boy. You want glitches? This app has so many glitches, it’s like a haunted house. You move a sound to another board, and then you gotta close the app. Delete a sound? Close the app. Breathe too hard near your phone? Close the app. Took me a whole week to figure out I’d been building soundboards on a broken platform. Should’ve seen the warning signs, but hey, I’m an optimist. And now I’m an idiot with a VMKey.

title: The mobile version of Voicemod should work like the desktop version. Besides that, it’s pretty good.
review: Honestly, it’s great that you can use it for testing purposes, recording voice changers, and uploading files to your soundboard. But it can be better if you can make it function the same way on the desktop version. How? For iOS, just use the PiP (Picture-in-Picture) feature where a mini window of your live soundboard shows on your screen so that you can use it while in a voice chat in a game like fortnite, roblox, rec room or other games and that includes social media voice chat like discord for example. Not just a digital soundboard screen you use for your console or whatever but would’ve been way more accessible if you can add this feature which I guess you can call it “Live Soundboard.”. with all of that in mind, I rate it a 4/5 Stars.

title: Ai slop fest and paywalls for everything
review: Genuinely irritated at how every last icon for voice effects is some ai slop generated image. It makes your software look cheap, lazy, and like you don’t care to spend genuine time making it look aesthetically cohesive. If you aren’t willing to take the time or spend money on REAL artists and REAL people to design your product, why should people be giving you money? Everything is locked behind a paywall, including trying to test/hear the pro voices. How would I even know if I wanted to upgrade to pro if I can’t see what I’m getting from it? Sloppy, lazily designed app imo. I would think twice about what corporations you’re giving money toward, and how those funds are utilized. If they’re cutting corners on basic design, what else are they cutting corners on? And just another friendly reminder that every company utilizing ai in their process—is directly responsible for large data center constructions and causing water pollution, deforestation, and reduced air quality to our communities.

title: Almost complete for VoiceMod Key usage (IOS, IPad)
review:
I have recently bought VoiceMod Key and I was excited to show my friend while playing Warframe (VM/Discord is separate from me playing on my iPhone); the thing that sucked though, is that the voice changer only happens for MY side of the voice chat, he can’t hear the effects that I’m switching to, only my regular mic audio.

 I plugged in my headset into the headphone port of the device, which goes into my iPad with the lightning cable adapter and it works just fine for hearing myself, albeit a little loud and my changed voice seems to overpower my own (might just be my mic’s audio on Discord). 

Another thing is that it might also just silence/quiet both our voices (at least on my end) when I have it plugged in. It also only seems to work if I have it on the app or with split-screen (preferably along with Discord), it (VM) doesn’t seem to work if I swipe out of VoiceMod to check something on Safari. 

Right now, I’m leaving 4 stars mainly because VoiceMod Key is brand new and people are barely using/reviewing it, but mainly the accessibility is what really needs to be worked on in conjunction with Discord in and out of both apps.
